name: omnilab/elevation
description: Omnilab Elevation: the elevation of points and of a profile between two points from a digital elevation model (SRTM, ASTER, EU-DEM, Mapzen, ETOPO1, GEBCO...), through Open Topo Data's public API or a self-hosted instance, as Points with their elevation in metres, outside the contract's shapes; no key needed (100 locations a call, a call a second, 1,000 a day on the public instance).
